subject.title: Write tool lacks append mode — isolated cron sessions destroy shared files

question: Should OpenClaw accept `append?: boolean` on the existing `write` tool as the permanent append contract for ordinary agent, cron, and monitor workflows?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible, but the remaining fix is a model-facing and extension-observable tool API decision rather than a purely internal bug patch.

options.title: Accept append on write
options.body: Land the open implementation after maintainer review, keeping overwrite as the default and using `append: true` for safe accumulation.

options.title: Choose another append contract
options.body: Ask for a replacement shape such as `mode: "append"` or a dedicated append tool before merging any public API.

options.title: Defer to workarounds
options.body: Keep relying on backup or `exec >>` workarounds, accepting that the ordinary write-tool data-loss risk remains.

recommendation.title: Accept append on write
recommendation.body: Land the open implementation after maintainer review, keeping overwrite as the default and using `append: true` for safe accumulation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the shared model-facing agent runtime write-tool contract, and his history is the strongest route for that surface.
